scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @delectable/api" "npm run dev -w @delectable/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @delectable/api && npm run build -w @delectable/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @delectable/web && npm run lint -w @delectable/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @delectable/web && npm run typecheck -w @delectable/api
